## Installers

| Platform | File | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 | [gigapair-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.msi](https://github.com/dopazo/gigapair/releases/download/__TAG__/gigapair-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.msi) | Double-click. Needs administrator rights. SmartScreen: **More info → Run anyway** |
| macOS, Apple silicon | [gigapair-aarch64-apple-darwin.dmg](https://github.com/dopazo/gigapair/releases/download/__TAG__/gigapair-aarch64-apple-darwin.dmg) | Open it and drag **Gigapair** to Applications |
| macOS, Intel | [gigapair-x86_64-apple-darwin.dmg](https://github.com/dopazo/gigapair/releases/download/__TAG__/gigapair-x86_64-apple-darwin.dmg) | Same. The first launch is blocked: **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** |
| Debian, Ubuntu and derivatives | [gigapair-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.deb](https://github.com/dopazo/gigapair/releases/download/__TAG__/gigapair-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.deb) | `sudo apt install ./gigapair-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.deb` (remove: `sudo apt remove gigapair`) |
| Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE | [gigapair-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.rpm](https://github.com/dopazo/gigapair/releases/download/__TAG__/gigapair-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.rpm) | `sudo dnf install ./gigapair-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.rpm` (remove: `sudo dnf remove gigapair`) |

Each file has a `.sha256` next to it. The apps are not code-signed or notarized. Other distributions and servers: the shell installer and the archives below. More in the [README](https://github.com/dopazo/gigapair#install).
